title: Fabulous food tour and guide
text: A fabulous food tour with a wonderful guide — Ariana. Really enjoyed and appreciated the cultural and historical insights and stories about the neighbourhoods, the shops, and the shopkeepers.

title: Great food tour in Barcelona
text: Had a great time on this tour. Alex was super informative nice and funny. The food was amazing and provided a good cross section of the food. Good price for the tour. And lasted about three hours.

title: Fantastic Food Tour in Barcelona!
text: We had a great experience with Alex today. We were a group of 6 and Alex ensured that we finished the tour absolutely stuffed with food and with knowledge of the food scene in Barcelona.  He was highly entertaining and provided background on the foods and their purveyors that we visited.  Absolutely recommend him!
author: maureensT7833YF

title: Food Tour
text: Alex was amazing!! We got to see so much and get great recommendations we never would have without him.

title: Alex was congenial and...
text: Alex was congenial and extremely informative. The selection of food encounters was wonderfully authentic.
author: Marie_D

title: Must Experience
text: Vera was the ultimate tour guide and was everything we could have asked for and more. Excellent food knowledge and a wealth of fun facts about Barcelona as a city and its culture. 11/10 recommend.
author: danicab611

title: Spanish food delights
text: This was a great introduction to the range of Spanish foods and specialties! Dom was fantastic! We loved all the places and found everything to be delicious. My husband’s gluten free requirements were also catered for! Superb tour!
author: Z3777XJdonnac

title: Food Tour Barcelona- Erik was amazing!
text: We did this food tour as a family of four.  It was my husband and I and our two kids ages 15 and 18.  Our tour guide’s name was Erik.  We were lucky to have a private food tour because we were the only group for that particular time which was AMAZING!  Erik took us to 6 different resteraunts highlighting popular Catalan and Spanish cuisines which were all absolutely delicious! The portion sizes of the dishes were quite big so we were absolutely stuffed by the end of the tour.
